response.text: {"question":"As of 22 May 2023, what recourse does a complainant have if they are dissatisfied with the redressal provided through SCORES, and within what time frame must they exercise it?","answer":"The complainant can request a one‑time review of the redressal decision within 15 days of the complaint’s closure on SCORES; if still unsatisfied, the matter is then escalated to the supervising official of the dealing officer of SEBI.","answerable":true}
